description: manni docs cite/set-up, run in a repo that holds the page's manni.config.yaml (collection docs-pages), docs/limits.md and lib/limits.ts.

steps.description: Mint the first citation, previewed: --dry-run prints the frontmatter diff.

runShell.command: manni cite add docs/limits.md:6 lib/limits.ts:2 --id fetch-timeout --dry-run

steps.description: Drop --dry-run to write it: the report names both pins and the claim's new file line.

runShell.command: manni cite add docs/limits.md:6 lib/limits.ts:2 --id fetch-timeout
runShell.stdio: /added fetch-timeout to frontmatter \(claim at line 16, sha256-921b21cc…; source lib\/limits\.ts:2 "export const FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000;"/

steps.description: The first check, with no arguments: the collection covers the page and both ends are current.

runShell.stdio: /fetch-timeout\s+:16 current\s+lib\/limits\.ts:2 current[\s\S]*1 file checked, 1 passed, 0 failed, 0 findings/

steps.description: From docs/, the root is still the git root, so the same sources resolve.
A wrong root reads the source end as missing rather than resolving the wrong file.

runShell.stdio: /lib\/limits\.ts:2 missing[\s\S]*1 file checked, 0 passed, 1 failed, 1 finding/

steps.description: No positional paths and no config is an operational error, exit 2.

runShell.stdio: No files to check. Pass paths/globs, or declare a collection under `collections:` in manni.config.yaml.
